title: Shipping a CLI with pnpm add -g github:.
description: Two pnpm errors, ERR_PNPM_EXOTIC_SUBDEP and ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED, and the pnpm 11 stale shims, from installing eng and shipper from GitHub.
lede: Our CLIs install straight from GitHub, with no npm publish. It works, but pnpm has rules about it. Here are the errors we hit, with their exact codes.
summary: ERR_PNPM_EXOTIC_SUBDEP, ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED and stale pnpm 10 shims: what broke when eng and shipper installed from GitHub, and what we changed.
